PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 20, 2025
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  ADMINISTRATION BUILDING ASSEMBLY ROOM, 9:00 AM

Gina Maguire, President  Naomi Rainey, Commissioner
Kevin Scott, Vice President  Robert Shannon, Commissioner
Gloria Cordero, Secretary

B. Anatole Falagán, General Manager  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney

 CALL TO ORDER

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 ROLL CALL

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  25-54390  Recommendation to approve February 6, 2025 Board meeting minutes.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  25-54391  Recommendation to receive and file the annual update from Carpi & Clay on
  federal legislative advocacy and lobbying services.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 3.  25-54392  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute a Memorandum of
  Understanding with WaterNow Alliance to provide assistance in the development
  of an Assembly Bill 1572 Program to assist Commercial, Industrial, and
  Institutional customers in removing their Non-Functional Turf.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 4.  25-54393  Recommendation to adopt Resolution UT-1531, A Resolution of the Board of
  Utilities Commissioners Adopting the Amended and Restated Water and Sewer
  Fund Annual Budget for Long Beach Public Utilities Department for Fiscal Year
  2023-2024 and authorize staff to transmit the Resolution and the Budget to the City
  Manager, Mayor and City Council.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 5.  25-54394  Board Workshop:
  Overview of trends in the Water and Sewer industries in southern California,
  including input from interviews with Long Beach Public Utilities Department staff
  and the Board, to provide background information for a future board retreat
  session.

  Suggested Action:  Receive and file.

5.  25-54394  Board Workshop:
  Overview of trends in the Water and Sewer industries in southern California,
  including input from interviews with Long Beach Public Utilities Department staff
  and the Board, to provide background information for a future board retreat
  session.

  The Board recessed at 9:53 AM.

  The Board reconvened at 10:10 AM.

  President Maguire began the workshop by inviting Anatole Falagan, General
  Manager, Utilities Department, to deliver opening remarks. Mr. Falagan explained
  the purpose of the workshop and its importance in guiding future planning. He then
  introduced Mr. Edward Means, President, Means Consulting LLC., who led the
  workshop session with his presentation. Key topics included aging infrastructure,
  technology, sustainability, workforce challenges, regulations, public trust, customer
  expectations, and affordability. The workshop concluded with the General Manager
  providing his closing remarks.

  Secretary Cordero spoke.

  President Maguire spoke.

  A motion was made by Secretary Cordero, seconded by Commissioner
  Shannon, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  4  Shannon, Cordero, Scott, Maguire
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Rainey

PUBLIC COMMENT

There were no comments from the public.

Anatole Falagan, General Manager, Utlities Department, spoke.

 Secretary Cordero announced that the Colorado River Board will be holding a board meeting and a
tour on Tuesday, March 11, 2025, at the Port of Long Beach. Additionally, there will be a Colorado
River Board retreat on Wednesday, March 12, 2025 from 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM, at the Port. She
advised anyone is welcome to attend the meeting and tour.

 President Maguire announced that some board members and staff will be attending the Urban Water
Institute Conference next week.

ADJOURNMENT

At 11:40 AM, President Maguire adjourned the meeting.
